examples.arabic: فكرة ممتازة، لأنني أحتاج حقاً إلى الوضوء بالماء البارد كي أستعيد نشاطي المفقود قبل تناول تلك الشاورما الساخنة.
examples.english: Excellent idea, because I really need to perform ablution with cold water in order to regain my lost energy before eating that hot shawarma.
examples.transliteration: Fikra mumtaza, li-annani ahtaju haqqan ila al-wudu' bil-ma' al-barid kay asta'ida nashati al-mafqud qabla tanawul tilka ash-shawarma as-sakhina.
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.arabic: وافقت سارة بسعادة وقالا تبدو فكرة رائعة
examples.english: Sara happily agreed and they said "That sounds like a great idea"
examples.transliteration: wāfaqat sāratu bisaʿādah wa qālā tabdū fikratan rāʾiʿatan

examples.english: This is a very good idea.
Ayman says: This is a good idea.

examples.arabic: كان الاطفال سعداء جدا بالفكرة للذهاب الى البحر.
examples.english: The children were very happy with the idea to go to the sea.
examples.transliteration: Kana al-atfalu su'ada' jiddan bil-fikrati li-l-dhahabi ila al-bahr.
